commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
fix: Slack skill now handles channel ID to name conversion

- Added Convert-ChannelReferencesToNames function to Search-SlackMessages.ps1
- Script now handles all channel reference variants:
  - in:#C06F7RT6U6L (channel ID) -> converts via API lookup
  - in:<#C06F7RT6U6L|productivity-engineering-public> -> extracts name
  - in:<#C06F7RT6U6L> -> looks up name from API
  - in:#productivity-engineering-public -> uses as-is
- Added MaximumIterationsPerRequest = 5 to prevent infinite tool loops
- Updated system-prompt.txt v1.11.0 with clearer Slack channel guidance
- Added debug logging to SkillInvocationService for troubleshooting
- Added test scripts for Slack token validation
